quote: We conducted two rounds of subjective evaluation, each consisting of a general and an expert listening test that focuses on controllability. ... guideline: Participants rated on a 7-point Likert scale using the PsyToolkit interface. Full questions and interface used are shown in Appendix G.

Participants rated each generated sample on a 7-point Likert scale for multiple criteria including audio quality, relevance, overall musical quality, rhythm consistency, harmony/consonance, and for experts also chord match and tempo match.

The participants were asked to rate the: i) audio rendering quality (AQ), ii) relevance of the audio with the input text prompt (REL), iii) overall musical quality (OMQ), iv) rhythm consistency (RC), and v) harmony and consonance of music (HC)... For the expert listening test, we added two additional music control-specific aspects to rate the degree to which the chords and tempo from the generated music match the text prompt. We denote them as MCM and MTM (musical chord/tempo match).
